title: MedBrains extension manifest v1
description: One manifest for every kind of extension (RFC-HOSPITAL-OS §8f item 3, §8g). The hospital sees exactly this before approving, and the extension gets exactly this. Server-side rules that JSON Schema cannot express (a read must be backed by its permission, events need a webhookUrl, data that is read must say where it goes) are listed in PROTOCOL.md §3 and enforced at registration.

kind.description: service = background integration; smart-app = screen launched inside MedBrains; mcp-tool = AI tool; wasm-block = flow block (installed through the store, not connected as an app).

purpose.description: One sentence: what it does for the hospital.

permissions.description: MedBrains permission codes (packages/types/src/permissions.ts). Wildcards and bypass roles are refused.

reads.description: FHIR R4 resources read in protocol v1. Patient needs patients.view, Encounter needs opd.queue.view, Observation needs lab.orders.view.

events.description: Clinical event names (packages/types CLINICAL_EVENT_I18N_KEYS), delivered as signed webhooks to webhookUrl.
